text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I need to lie down on the sofa.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. Even an honor student like
myself needs
a break every once in a
while.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...And since it's just you here,
this place
is perfect.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm gonna be here for a bit.
Now go get
back to your work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Daiwa Scarlet is worn out...
I'll have
to make sure I don't push her
too hard.
